title: Ensemble Logic
abstract: arXiv:2408.14443v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ensemble Logic (EL) is a family of modal logics whose modal parameters are terms with quantified variables. We interpret formulas over metric monoids, that is, commutative monoids equipped with translation-invariant metrics. Displacement evaluates a formula at a translated point, while bounded existence and bounded universality evaluate it at some or every point of a window of prescribed length. Quantification over points and lengths allows the same variable to occur in the parameters of several operators. This provides a common framework for temporal and spatial reasoning in discrete, dense and multi-dimensional settings. Our main result establishes a sharp undecidability boundary for satisfiability over the natural numbers: satisfiability is undecidable already for formulas $\exists N\,\exists n\,\Psi$ in which $\Psi$ is built from the letters of a fixed alphabet by conjunction, disjunction, displacement and bounded universal

translated_abstract: 集合逻辑是一族模态逻辑，其模态参数是含量化变量的项。我们在度量幺半群（即配备平移不变度量的交换幺半群）上解释公式。位移算子在平移后的点上对公式求值，而有界存在和有界全称算子在指定长度的窗口内的某个点或每个点上对公式求值。对点和长度的量化允许同一变量出现在多个算子的参数中。这为离散、稠密和多维设置中的时间推理和空间推理提供了一个统一的框架。我们的主要结果建立了自然数上可满足性的尖锐不可判定性边界：对于形如 $\exists N\,\exists n\,\Psi$ 的公式，其中 $\Psi$ 由固定字母表中的字母通过合取、析取、位移和有界全称量词构造而成，其可满足性已经是不可判定的。
tldr: 本文提出集合逻辑（EL）这一族模态逻辑，在度量幺半群上统一了离散、稠密和多维设置下的时间与空间推理，并证明了自然数上可满足性的尖锐不可判定性边界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Ensemble Logic (EL), a family of modal logics over metric monoids that provides a unified framework for temporal and spatial reasoning in discrete, dense, and multi-dimensional settings, and establishes a sharp undecidability boundary for satisfiability over the natural numbers.
